# Contoso Order Desk: instructions for GitHub Copilot

## Project overview
Order Desk is an internal web app for Contoso customer care agents.
Agents look up an order by order number and see its status and estimated delivery date.
All data in `data/orders.json` is synthetic and generated by `scripts/seed-orders.mjs`.

## Tech stack
- Node.js 24, Express 5, ES modules (import/export).
- Tests use the built-in Node.js test runner (`node --test`) with `fetch` against an ephemeral server.
  Do not add other test frameworks.
- The front end is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in `public/`. No front-end frameworks or build step.

## Commands
- `npm ci` installs dependencies, `npm test` runs every test, `npm start` serves the app on port 3000.

## Coding standards
- Use semicolons at the end of each statement.
- Use single quotes for strings.
- Keep route handlers small; put business logic in `src/` modules that can be unit tested.
- Validate every request parameter. Order numbers match `ORD-` followed by six digits.
- Return errors as JSON `{ "error": "<message>" }` with the correct HTTP status code.

## Data protection
- API responses return only the fields a screen needs, from an explicit allow-list.
- Agents must never see payment details or customer contact details (email, phone).
- Do not log customer email addresses or phone numbers.

## Front end
- Reuse the Contoso design system in `public/styles.css` (classes start with `od-`): `od-card`, `od-field`,
  `od-input-group`, `od-input`, `od-btn`, `od-badge--{pending|packed|shipped|out|delivered|cancelled}`,
  `od-alert--{warn|danger|info}`, `od-facts`/`od-fact`, `od-tracker`, `od-chip`, `od-skeleton`.
  Put page-specific CSS in `public/app.css`.
- Keep the top bar, hero and footer from `public/index.html`.
- Put pure helpers (formatting, validation) in `public/*.js` modules with no DOM access, and unit test them.
- Insert API data with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`.
- Accessibility: every input has a visible label, results are announced through an `aria-live="polite"` region,
  everything works with the keyboard, and colour is never the only signal.

## Security
- Never build HTML or queries by concatenating user input; encode output.
- Never commit secrets, keys or connection strings. Configuration comes from environment variables.

## Pull requests
- Every change includes or updates tests, and `npm test` must pass.
- Reference the issue in the pull request description with "Fixes #<number>".
